title: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland — curated real-novel regression corpus
notice: The English excerpts are curated from the actual novel. The baselineTranslations and improvedExampleTranslations are hand-authored failure-control examples, not outputs measured from an LLM, not a published Chinese translation, and not evidence of model-quality improvement. The corpus validates reproducible checks; quality claims require matched real local-agent runs and blind human review.

source.corpusMethod: Curated source excerpts from Chapters I, II, V, VI and VII in source chronology: White Rabbit/bottle/shrinking, the pool and identity puzzle, Caterpillar, the Duchess passage preceding Cheshire Cat, then the Mad Tea-Party. Ordinals reflect the curated source order for chronology-boundary tests.
